__comment: OAuth2 replaces the dead username/password validator. customUI hosts the consent webview (like com.palm.eas / com.palm.skype); it loads OAuth2.buildAuthorizeUrl(), captures ?code= from the redirect to Config.REDIRECT_URI, then calls exchangeCode which returns the stored token credentials. Yandex Disk provides BOTH DOCUMENTS and PHOTO.UPLOAD (photo source + device->cloud upload).
__comment2: com.palm.app.cloud-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists (accounts/handlers/create.js -> Utils.hasPermission). Working templates (teams/telegram/skype) list their own auth app, not com.palm.app.accounts.
__comment3: com.palm.service.yandexdisk is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops and writeCredentials back after a token refresh (accounts/handlers/credentials.js checks these lists).

capabilityProviders.__comment: No longer bound to QuickOffice (closed/dead). The file-picker app and the QuickOffice reroute (mxId 'yandex') consume listFolder/downloadFile/uploadFile.

Makes the Yandex Disk account a photo source (and device->cloud upload target). implementation/hooks point at the stock Photos AGGREGATOR (com.palm.service.photos), which discovers PHOTO.UPLOAD accounts and - via the templateId->serviceName fall-through in its Utils.js (see ../photos-integration/) - calls com.palm.service.yandexdisk/listAlbums+listPhotos, then downloads bytes with the curl-patched Sync-Manager. One folder is surfaced as one album: Yandex's own camera-uploads folder (system_folders.photostream) when it exists, else Config.PHOTO_ALBUM_NAME ('Pictures'). Like Dropbox, src_big/src_small are short-lived signed /resources/download hrefs (self-authenticating, so the curl -L fetch needs no auth header).
